title: Signature Approach for Contextual Bandits with Nonlinear and Path-dependent Rewards: Regret Bound and Statistical Inference
abstract: arXiv:2605.10313v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study contextual bandits with nonlinear and path-dependent rewards through a novel signature-transform-based approach. Leveraging the universal nonlinearity property of signatures, we approximate continuous path-dependent reward functionals by linear functionals in the signature space. This representation enables the use of efficient linear contextual bandit methods while preserving expressive sequential structure. Building on this framework, we propose \texttt{DisSigUCB}, a signature-based disjoint upper confidence bound (UCB) algorithm. translated_title: 基于签名方法的非线性和路径依赖奖励上下文老虎机：遗憾界与统计推断
translated_abstract: 我们通过一种新颖的基于签名变换的方法研究具有非线性和路径依赖奖励的上下文老虎机。利用签名的通用非线性特性，我们用签名空间中的线性泛函来近似连续的路径依赖奖励泛函。这种表示使得在保留丰富的序列结构表达能力的同时，能够使用高效的线性上下文老虎机方法。在该框架基础上，我们提出了 DisSigUCB——一种基于签名的分离式上置信界（UCB）算法。在有界性和非退化性假设下，我们建立了阶为 \(\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d_{\text{Sig}}\sqrt{KT} + \varepsilon_N T\sqrt{d_{\text{Sig}}})\) 的高概率遗憾界，其中 K 为动作数量，d_Sig 为签名特征维度，ε_N 为有限深度近似误差。我们进一步引入了 ζ-DisSigUCB……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于签名变换的 DisSigUCB 算法，将路径依赖的非线性奖励泛函近似为签名空间中的线性泛函，从而高效求解非线性和路径依赖奖励的上下文老虎机问题，并建立了高概率遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DisSigUCB, a signature-transform-based algorithm that approximates nonlinear, path-dependent reward functionals as linear functionals in signature space, enabling efficient contextual bandits with high-probability regret guarantees.
